## Shape

A diagram or API sketch. A theme-aware SVG goes inside a `{=html}` block and
colors only with `var(--bs-body-color)` / `var(--bs-<semantic>)` (+ `fill-opacity`),
never hardcoded hex, so it survives the light↔dark toggle. Inline sizing on the
`<svg>` is fine; only color must stay theme-driven.

```{=html}
<figure class="text-center my-4">
<svg role="img" viewBox="0 0 480 120" style="width:100%;max-width:480px;height:auto;font-family:inherit;font-size:13px">
  <rect x="40" y="40" width="160" height="44" rx="8" fill="var(--bs-info)" fill-opacity="0.15" stroke="var(--bs-info)"/>
  <text x="120" y="67" text-anchor="middle" fill="var(--bs-body-color)">before</text>
  <rect x="280" y="40" width="160" height="44" rx="8" fill="var(--bs-success)" fill-opacity="0.15" stroke="var(--bs-success)"/>
  <text x="360" y="67" text-anchor="middle" fill="var(--bs-body-color)">after</text>
  <line x1="200" y1="62" x2="280" y2="62" stroke="var(--bs-body-color)"/>
</svg>
</figure>
```
